title: An unforgettable day in Córdoba, thanks to two outstanding guides
text:
The day trip from Seville to Córdoba was one of the highlights of our stay in Andalusia, and that was largely thanks to our guide, Pia. She made the most of every minute on the bus, sharing fascinating insights into the history of Spain, Seville and Córdoba, explaining the influence of the Romans, Christians, Muslims and Jews on the region's rich cultural heritage, as well as the Mudéjar style that emerged from their coexistence. We also had a brief stop in Carmona, which was a lovely addition to the journey.

title: Visit to Cordoba and the Mosque-Cathedral with Fouad and Ricardo
text:
We took the organized trip departing from Seville by bus to Cordoba.
Very good day with our passionate and fascinating guide Fouad.
Thanks to him for his explanations, and for sharing the history and culture of Andalusia.
A big thank you also to Ricardo for his tour in French of the Mosque-Cathedral, an astonishing monument unique in the world that shows that people and religions can live together for centuries.

title: Great tour of Cordoba!
text: This was a great full-day tour. The first stop at Carmona was well-timed and really pretty. Cordoba was wonderful. Our guide, Merce, was so knowledgeable and just great. And the Mezquita itself was incredible. The day was outstanding.
author: William_R

title: Excellent excursion!
text:
We thoroughly enjoyed our day trip to Cordoba with Merce! She is very enthusiastic and knowledgeable and kept the fairly large group moving along effectively. Whisper boxes were used through much of the trip, which was appreciated. The coach was very comfortable, the rest stops well planned. The side visit to Carmona was just enough to get a brief taste of the city. 
The tour of the Mesquita was excellent! We had been before, a few years ago, but this tour was definitely superior. Highly recommend! Thank you Merce
author: 152brentj

title: Excellent and Informative Trip with Merce
text: This was an excellent tour. Merce was a great tour guide who had excellent knowledge that was easily conveyed across multiple languages (English and Italian). She also infused humor into her explanation which made them easier stay engaged with. She also answered many questions from the group and was not stumped by anything! She also had a great personal touch with the younger member of the group. The guide of the Cordoba Mosque/Cathedral was also excellent and truly one of the most unique places I have seen.
